verdict.rationale: Weave can be driven through natural language indirectly. The official W&B MCP server and W&B Skills let a chat agent or coding assistant answer questions about traces, evaluations and runs, and agents like Claude Code can read production data, run evaluations and execute iteration loops. All of this depends on an external agent client; no native natural-language command interface inside Weave is evidenced. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface in the Weave UI, evidence of which product operations (beyond reading data and running evaluations) can be done by natural-language command, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
